# Getting help with Unpause

1. **Read what Unpause says.** When a game does not start, the Recovery screen names the cause and the next step; a game's
   Options › **Check this system** runs the Doctor for that console.
2. **Check the guides**: [install](https://github.com/GigaRho/unpause-releases/blob/main/INSTALL.md),
   [updates](https://github.com/GigaRho/unpause-releases/blob/main/UPDATING.md) and the
   [FAQ](https://github.com/GigaRho/unpause-releases/blob/main/FAQ.md).
3. **Ask** in [Q&A](https://github.com/GigaRho/unpause-feedback/discussions/categories/q-a). Someone may have had the same question; mark the answer that
   helped so the next person finds it.
4. **Report a bug** if Unpause did something wrong: Settings › Help & feedback fills in the form for you.

We cannot help with finding games, BIOS files or keys, or with setting up an emulator outside Unpause.
